sections.heading: Where We Fly
sections.body: We currently service Australia, Republic of Naoero, Fiji, Republic of Kiribati, and the Republic of the Marshall Islands. We look forward to adding even more exciting destinations in the future! The first step in planning your ideal holiday in the Pacific is deciding what type of vacation is best for you. Who are you going with? Whether you're travelling solo, with friends, family or a partner, once you've decided that, it's time to pick the style of vacation you're after. The Pacific truly has something to suit everyone.
